expression: \t1 t2 -> case unify (t1 :: Ty) t2 of { Right s -> applySubst s t1 == applySubst s t2; Left _ -> True }
\t -> case unify (t :: Ty) t of { Right s -> applySubst s t == t; Left _ -> False }
\s1 s2 s3 -> let t = TVar "x" in applySubst (composeSubst (composeSubst s1 s2) s3) t == applySubst (composeSubst s1 (composeSubst s2 s3)) t
\e -> case typeOf (e :: Expr) of { Right _ -> case evalClosed e of { Right _ -> True; Left _ -> False }; Left _ -> True }
